roleAssessment.finding: Stripe has mixed legal roles. When processing Personal Data on behalf of CAPITAL-AI under the DPA, Stripe acts as Data Processor. For specified purposes including fraud/risk prevention, financial-provider selection, legal/regulatory compliance, relationship management and product analysis/development, Stripe acts as Data Controller.
roleAssessment.scopeLimitation: Do not classify Stripe globally as processor or controller; role is purpose- and processing-specific.

transferAssessment.finding: The DPA states that User transfers Personal Data to Stripe, LLC in the United States as necessary to provide the Services and that Stripe/Affiliates may transfer Personal Data globally.

precedence: EEA SCCs or UK International Data Transfer Addendum as applicable
mechanisms.dpf: Stripe, LLC states that it is self-certified under the Data Privacy Framework.

transferAssessment.note: Contractual transfer mechanisms are evidenced, but this record does not claim that a CAPITAL-AI-specific transfer assessment/TIA is complete.
